dimensions.measures: Floor-to-ceiling height of the uppermost (top) tier of the East elevation, from the ceiling/cornice line above the band of glazed and panelled units down to the floor line at the base of that band

dimensions.measures: Vertical distance between the floor line of the top tier and the ceiling line of the middle tier, i.e. the height of the brick cap/floor zone above the middle-tier ceiling (the band containing the moulded cornice profile and the circular pipe/bracket section)

dimensions.measures: Floor-to-ceiling height of the middle tier of the East elevation, from the middle-tier ceiling/cornice line down to the floor line at the hearth of the middle fireplace
dimensions.location_on_sheet: East elevation, right-hand vertical dimension string, third segment from top

dimensions.measures: Floor-to-ceiling height of the lowest tier of the East elevation, from the ceiling/soffit line beneath the middle-tier floor down to the floor line at the base of the lower fireplace
dimensions.location_on_sheet: East elevation, right-hand vertical dimension string, bottom segment

notes: Only one dimension string exists on the sheet (four vertical heights on the East elevation); the West elevation carries no written dimensions. All four values and the scale note read clearly at tile resolution; the graphic bar scale graduations (0, 1, 5) are scale marks, not building dimensions, and are not listed. Faint pencil construction lines on the right of the top tier of the West elevation carry no text.
